hooks.name: Validate prd_progress.json
hooks.description: After any save of the FDD progress file, make sure it is still valid JSON with a features map.

action.command: node -e "const p=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('docs/prd_progress.json','utf8')); if(!p.features) throw new Error('docs/prd_progress.json: missing features map, expected {schema_version, features:{F01:{...}}}');"

hooks.name: Keep .kiro in sync with .claude
hooks.description: When a Claude-side skill, command or agent changes, regenerate the Kiro copies.
